text:
Scale: the square plate spans roughly 450 px, which I take as about 26 cm, so about 17 px per cm.

Caesar salad: the romaine pile covers about 200x250 px, which is roughly 12x14 cm. It is loosely piled and about 3 cm high, so I estimate about 90 g of lettuce with dressing. I count the dressing separately at about 15 g.

Broccoli: one small floret piece, about 5x6 cm and 3 cm tall, so about 45 g.

Tomato-sauce chicken or tofu dish (upper right): it covers about 10x9 cm and is about 2.5 cm high, so about 150 g.

Brown rice and vegetable mix (lower right): this includes the rice, a tomato, a piece of tofu and some broccoli. It covers about 7x8 cm, so about 90 g for the rice and vegetables together. I list the broccoli in that mix separately at about 30 g and put the rice, tofu and vegetables at about 70 g.
